sequence.subject: A power-user tool for your ClinicPlus account (100 free credits inside)
sequence.preview: ClinicPlus Booking Companion is a standalone account-management tool by Namoota Technology. Try it free with 100 credits.
sequence.headline: Manage your ClinicPlus account like a power user
sequence.intro: ClinicPlus Booking Companion is a standalone product built by Namoota Technology to help ClinicPlus clients manage their accounts, rosters, and bookings far faster than the ClinicPlus website alone.
body: It is not a free app — Companion is a credit-based tool built for teams who book occupational health medicals often enough that retyping employee details every time has become real, recurring work. Your invitation includes 100 free credits so you can try every feature before spending a cent.
Companion is completely optional. It never replaces the ClinicPlus bookings website — you can keep booking there directly at any time, with or without Companion.
bullets: Import employees straight from your past ClinicPlus appointments — no manual retyping of a single record
Group employees by site, shift, department, or occupation, then book that whole group in a few clicks
Create a real ClinicPlus appointment for one employee, a company's entire staff, a group, or everyone in a given occupation
Save ID/passport numbers, occupations, default services, and job spec files once and reuse them on every booking
Manage multiple companies from one account, each with its own employees, sites, and billing details
Track medical and service expiry dates per employee so renewals are booked before they lapse, not after
See your own spend, revenue, and appointment history broken down by service, month, and company
Check clinic capacity by date before you book, so you know instantly if a date is full

featureGrid.title: Import from history
featureGrid.description: Pull employees straight out of appointments you've already booked through ClinicPlus, complete with occupation and ID details, instead of typing them in from scratch.

featureGrid.title: Employee groups
featureGrid.description: Group your workforce by crew, department, site, or occupation, then select the whole group with one click when a new booking comes up.

featureGrid.title: Book by company, group, or occupation
featureGrid.description: Create one appointment for a company's entire staff, a specific group, or everyone with a given occupation — not just one person at a time.

featureGrid.title: Compliance tracking
featureGrid.description: See which employees have a medical or service expiring soon, so renewal bookings happen ahead of the deadline.

sequence.footNote: Companion is a paid, credit-based tool for power users of ClinicPlus account management. These 100 credits are a free trial, not an ongoing free tier — pricing for every action is always shown before you confirm it.

sequence.subject: Every feature in ClinicPlus Booking Companion, explained
sequence.preview: Roster imports, employee groups, bulk company bookings, compliance tracking, and spend insights — all in one place.
sequence.headline: Here is everything Companion actually does
sequence.intro: The invitation email covered the headline. Here is the complete picture of what a paid Companion subscription unlocks for teams booking medicals through ClinicPlus.
body: Companion sits alongside ClinicPlus, not instead of it. Everything you build here — rosters, groups, companies — exists to make the appointments you create in ClinicPlus's own system faster to put together, especially when you're booking for the same people or the same company again and again.
bullets: Import employees from past appointments — bring in name, ID/passport number, and occupation from bookings you've already made, so historical employees don't need to be recreated by hand
Build and manage an employee roster — save every employee once, with their sites, default services, job spec files, and notes attached
Create and manage employee groups — crews, shifts, departments, or occupations — and add or remove members at any time
Register and manage companies — keep each company's registered details, billing information, and connected employees in one record
Book for a whole company at once — select every employee linked to a company and submit one bulk appointment
Book by group or occupation — filter your roster to a group or an occupation and book only those employees
Book for a single employee — Companion also handles the simple one-person booking, with the same saved details reused
Reuse job spec files — upload a job spec once per employee and it's ready for every future booking, no re-uploading
Check clinic availability by month — see daily capacity at Hendrina and Churchill before you pick a date
Track compliance and renewals — a dashboard of which employees' medicals or services are due, overdue, or current
View spend and appointment insights — credit spend, revenue, and service breakdowns by month and by company
Manage your credit wallet — top up, see your balance before every action, and review a full transaction ledger
Multi-company access — managers who oversee more than one company can switch between them from a single login
sequence.footNote: As a credit-based tool, every one of these actions has a visible price before you confirm it. Nothing is charged automatically, and your 100 trial credits let you explore the whole feature set before deciding if it's worth paying for.

sequence.subject: Last reminder: your 100 free credits expire with this invite
sequence.preview: Try the roster, groups, and bulk booking tools before your next booking cycle — no obligation, no ClinicPlus account changes.
sequence.headline: Make your next booking cycle lighter
sequence.intro: A saved roster and a few employee groups are easiest to set up before the next urgent booking request lands, not during it.
body: Log in with your existing ClinicPlus account, claim the 100-credit trial, and import a handful of employees from your booking history to see how the flow feels.

Companion is built by Namoota Technology as a standalone, optional tool — using it never changes how your ClinicPlus account works, and you can stop using it at any time without affecting your ability to book directly through ClinicPlus.
bullets: No new ClinicPlus account needed — log in with what you already have
Import employees from appointment history, group them, and book a whole company or occupation in one submission
Credit cost is always visible before you confirm an action — nothing runs automatically
You stay in full control of what gets submitted to ClinicPlus
sequence.footNote: This is the final email in this invitation sequence. If Companion isn't for you, no further action is needed and you won't be re-invited.
